title: judge validation report
description: A scorer's judges against one source of human ratings: data/judge-validation/<scorer>/<source>/report.json, written by harness/tools/validate_judge_goyal.py and validate_judge_zhang.py from the records beside it. These are the fields both sources have; each source adds its own numbers (best-pick agreement, system means, rankings). The scorer's `validation` block names the runs that measured its judges; this is the check against people.

source.description: Who rated, and where the ratings are from.

scorer.description: The scorer whose judges were checked; the folder's.

records_sha256.description: One hash over the judge's records (judge_score.records_sha256), so the report is checked against them where the human data is absent.

scorer_sha256.description: The hash of the scorer's content (the parsed YAML) when the judges were checked.

human_baseline.description: How well people agree with each other on this source: what the judges are held to.
